status: Native guitarist action template, validated with sampled in-game proof; retail PS2 execution unverified

frame_provenance.method: Rigid nearest-point fit between source PS2 Epiphone Explorer and stock GH2 Xplorer, expressed in their guitar bind-local frames; then fret rotation matched to stock prop bind marker

limitations: Source delta rotation order inferred; retail PS2 execution not validated
Fret and synchronized actions are source-pose adaptations, not copies of stock character motion
Face and hair can reset phase between body clips; normal clip blending is retained, exhaustive seam review not performed
Bass slap/pluck and retail-only interaction/exclusion consumers are outside this native guitarist contract

mapping_notes.star_power: Source specials: activation semantics and timing require visual/runtime verification
mapping_notes.ui: Frontend transition and idle; continuity pending
mapping_notes.omissions: Source-only battle attacks/reactions and optional bassist/retail interaction consumers are not claimed as covered.
mapping_notes.strum_variants: Source short/medium/long families preserved. GH2 long variants 3/4 reuse source long variants 1/2 because the PS2 source supplies only two long strokes.
mapping_notes.finger_holds: Source selected-finger compositions; high-register variants use separately fitted source finger layers. Native solo calls and sampled guitar contact verified.
mapping_notes.vibrato: Source wrist bend ramp ping-ponged over the target vibrato cycle, with separate high finger poses. Native high-vibrato selection and sampled contact verified.
mapping_notes.locomotion: Source forward/back strides and stops, virtual facing extraction, procedural heading adaptation and pose-matched transition graph. Native turn/walk/stop completion and body/instrument continuity verified.
mapping_notes.chords: Source finger-channel compositions selected against stock distal bend signatures. No donor skeletal motion copied. Visual review is sampled, not every chord and frame.
mapping_notes.win_finals: Campaign victory uses source win3, not the unrelated final-strum action.

action_notes.sync_head_bang: Adapted from existing source fast/medium head-nodding performance loops; no custom pose keys
action_notes.sync_wag: Adapted from existing source swaying performance loops; no custom pose keys
action_notes.bass: Guitarist-only conversion. Source has no bassist slap/pluck actions; those optional role calls are excluded.
action_notes.retail: Native game validation required. Retail PS2 GH2 runtime compatibility is not yet verified.
